items.description: Track the contractual notice for the redelivery of VSL-12 at Casablanca, ensuring all details regarding the joint on/off survey by Vanguard are noted.
Confirm the bunker ROB of 318 mt VLSFO at the redelivery price of USD 598 per mt for VSL-12.
Arrange the joint on/off survey for VSL-12 at Casablanca with Vanguard as specified in the email.
